neighbours.label: organisational mission prose: the token that opens the statement of a cause or of a named initiative (' to' + mission verb after 'uses X'; 'called' / 'its' before a programme name)
fire: The charity uses solar lamps to bring light to families living off the grid.
The ministry, working with UNICEF, unveiled a new campaign called Every Girl Learns.
Founded in 2009, the group harnesses the web to advance its goal of universal literacy.
A share of every sale goes to Clean Rivers, a project that is part of the Global Water Fund.
The university wants to use open courses to further its mission of spreading knowledge.
Backed by the mayor's Connected City Initiative, the plan would link every school to fast broadband.
The company's Global Impact Report shows how its suppliers meet ethical standards.
The alliance is working with farmers to build a scalable platform for fair trade.
quiet: The camper uses a gas lamp to read his book inside the tent.
The bakery, next to the church, unveiled a new cake called Lemon Cloud.
Built in 2009, the cabin has a stove to heat the single room.
A slice of every pie goes to my brother, a boy who is always hungry.
The student wants to use the weekend to finish her essay on Hamlet.
Chased by the neighbour's angry dog, the cat would climb every tree on the street.
The team's final match report shows how its defenders lost the ball.
The plumber is working with his son to fix a leaking pipe in the cellar.
